Hamburger Mashed Potato Pie
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:50pm

Ingredients




1 pound ground beef
1 can cream of mushroom soup
1 soup can of milk
mashed potatoes

Preparation

1 Brown the ground beef and drain. Put into a baking dish. Mix soup and milk. Add to hamburger. Mix well. Top with mashed potatoes(real or instant) Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 15 minutes, or until heated completely through, and potatoes are starting to turn golden brown on top. Serve with a vegetable and fresh bread.
